title: Company Profile & Onboarding
markdown:
**What it is:** Your company's identity and strategy — mission, market, competitors, financials, and org structure — that grounds everything the Executive says.

**What it does:**

- Walk through a guided **onboarding wizard** the first time, which bootstraps your profile from a few questions.
- View and edit every section of the profile inline, any time afterward.
- Feed this context to all specialists so advice fits *your* company, not a generic one.
- Kick off background research after setup to suggest things worth watching.

*Note: until a profile exists, the app nudges you to set one up — it's the foundation the rest builds on.*
